refused.quote:
it ought to be replaced by a principle
of perfect equality, admitting no power or privilege on the one side,
nor disability on the other.
refused.reason: 开头要求以完全平等取代法律上的从属。这是规范主张。

refused.quote:
will probably hold its ground until it
gives way before a sound psychology, laying bare the real root of
much that is bowed down to as the intention of Nature and the
ordinance of God.
refused.reason: 对本能的崇拜大概会维持到健全心理学揭示其根。两个对象都没有可观察指标。

refused.quote:
of itself prove that the assimilation must go on to complete
equality; but it assuredly affords some presumption that such is the
refused.reason: 他写明历史不能单独证明会走到完全平等，只提供某种推定。

refused.quote:
always will be so, until women themselves have told
all that they have to tell.
refused.reason: 了解在妇女说出一切之前将始终贫乏。一切和贫乏都没有阈值。

refused.quote:
justice will again be the primary
virtue
refused.reason: 正义再次成为首要德性。首要德性没有公共指标。

refused.quote:
The moral regeneration
of mankind will only really commence, when the most fundamental of
the social relations is placed under the rule of equal justice, and
when human beings learn to cultivate their strongest sympathy with an
equal in rights and in cultivation.
refused.reason: 道德再生只在平等关系下开始。道德再生没有可核验对象。

refused.quote:
The case will be even more frequent, as increased
cultivation creates a greater and greater disproportion between the
ideas and faculties of women, and the scope which society allows to
their activity.
refused.reason: 虚度之感变得更常见，以培养和活动范围的差距继续扩大为条件，而且没有频率序列。
他自己把脑的大小推测称为完全是假说。

refused.quote:
I hope will some day be
published
refused.reason: 他希望一部没有写出书名的著作有一天出版，没有断言它必将出版。

refused.quote:
Updated editions will replace the previous one—the old editions will
be renamed.
refused.reason: 这句在古腾堡结束标记之后，是许可证，不是 Mill。
